scenarios.prompt: An existing component has R1 passed. Design the change using only srs.md; the agent has not read specs/design.md or delta-spec.md.
expected: refuses to design from the SRS alone
reads baseline-ready canonical spec and design plus delta-spec and verifies their recorded revisions
derives affected design sections and decisions from the spec delta before writing delta-design.md

scenarios.prompt: The first AR for componentMode=new has EMPTY canonical baselines and a complete ADDED delta-spec.
expected: allows design without invoking baseline initialization
uses ADDED design operations with component-template chapter/entity targets and stable DD/DEC/TC IDs
makes the delta complete enough to construct the first canonical design from an empty baseline

scenarios.prompt: The AR changes only the invalid-input error mapping for one row in section 6.1.3. Inputs, outputs, success side effects, timing, and compatibility remain unchanged.
expected: writes a MODIFIED operation whose selector targets only the error contract field
includes base and resulting local content plus a preservation clause for all untouched contract fields
does not rewrite the whole interface section or silently remove existing semantics

scenarios.prompt: delta-design is based on revision abc, but the same target decision in specs/design.md changed at revision def.
expected: detects the overlapping canonical change
stops for semantic conflict resolution rather than overwriting the newer decision
does not advance R2 until base provenance is reconciled

scenarios.prompt: change.json profile is elevated. Its evidence-based reasons identify concurrency and real-time changes, and requiredEvidence asks for integration and repeatable timing results; security and data migration are not applicable.
expected: always completes core and expands concurrency and real-time sections with risks and verification cases
records evidence-backed N/A entries for security and data-migration without generating empty boilerplate sections
maps profile reasons and required evidence to component chapter/entity anchors and Case IDs

scenarios.prompt: The SRS changes a safety-critical shutdown path, but change.json has no complete profile name, risk, reasons, requiredEvidence, or requiredReviewers.
expected: treats the missing or inconsistent profile as blocking
asks for profile ownership, evidence, and reviewer decisions instead of silently choosing a low-risk shape
does not set R2 pending while the risk coverage contract is unresolved

scenarios.prompt: The proposed delta-design contains a module diagram and file list but no options, full contract, error model, risks, migration decision, or test design.
expected: rejects the design as incomplete
requires a justified option/decision plus contracts, failure-state guarantees, ownership, risks, migration or N/A evidence, and rollback
requires a stable Case Index covering all SRS acceptance and regression obligations

scenarios.prompt: The delta spec needs one file logger, but the design adds a plugin registry and backend abstraction solely for possible future backends.
expected: challenges abstractions that have no current requirement or real variation axis
records the simplest viable decision and why it satisfies the delta spec
does not use future-proofing alone to justify complexity

scenarios.prompt: delta-design is ready, but traceability still says TBD(design) and the designer wants R2 review.
expected: blocks R2 readiness
fills Design Section/Case with component chapter/entity, DEC, and TC anchors for every row keyed by 需求条目
preserves the fixed 需求条目 to Spec Section to Design Section/Case to Task to Code/Test to Evidence chain

scenarios.prompt: The proposed component design baseline contains only context, units, interfaces, and a test map. It omits the complete function baseline, development/runtime views, applicable database/UI design, key functions, software units, review record, and cost assessment.
expected: rejects the incomplete canonical design
requires every component design section to contain real content or auditable N/A evidence
keeps change-local task and gate state out of the canonical document

scenarios.prompt: delta-design has a valid DD-001 operation and preservation clause but omits the change overview, dynamic behavior, implementation/data/interface/code design, domain scenarios, refactoring, and layered tests.
expected: rejects the operation-only delta as insufficient for implementation and review
requires every change-design section to contain applicable details or auditable N/A evidence
uses section 7 for base, operations, selectors, preservation, conflict, and merge-review information
leaves design-quality judgment to the independent R2 review

scenarios.prompt: After finishing delta-design, the author directly edits specs/design.md and marks R2 passed.
expected: rejects direct canonical mutation during the design stage
marks only the deltaDesign artifact ready and R2 pending in change.json
leaves R2 verdict to an independent reviewer and canonical synchronization to the closeout flow
